title: A/SF-01 B-wing (Star Wars, Return of the Jedi)

sources.title: List of Star Wars starfighters: B-wing (Wikipedia)

intro: The B-wing is a fictional heavy Rebel assault fighter from the Star Wars films, first seen in Return of the Jedi. Its long wing turns around a cockpit pod that stays level (gyro-stabilised), so the pilot keeps the horizon while the rest of the ship rotates. One pilot sits in that pod at one end of the wing.

areas.name: Canopy
areas.text: The forward view from the stabilised pod.

panels.name: Canopy
panels.text: The window of the cockpit pod, with a view forward.
panels.context: Because the pod stays level, the view does not spin when the ship rolls.

controls.name: Gyro-stabilised pod
controls.text: The cockpit pod stays level while the long main wing rotates around it.
controls.context: This keeps the pilot's view steady, so the pilot does not get dizzy when the ship turns its wing.

areas.name: Instrument panel
areas.text: The panel in front of the pilot in the cockpit pod.

panels.name: Instrument panel
panels.text: Screens and lights in front of the pilot.
panels.context: They show targets and the state of the ship.

controls.name: Forward displays
controls.text: Screens in front of the pilot show targeting and sensor pictures.
controls.context: The B-wing attacks big ships, so the pilot picks targets on these screens.

controls.name: Status lights
controls.text: Small system lights on the B-wing's panel in the pod.
controls.context: The film does not explain each light.

panels.name: Side consoles
panels.text: Switches beside the seat and the weapon selection.
panels.context: The B-wing carries several kinds of weapons.

controls.name: Switch banks
controls.text: Toggle switches on both sides of the B-wing pilot's seat.
controls.context: They belong to the ship's systems; the film does not name them.

controls.name: Weapon selection
controls.text: The B-wing has laser cannons, ion cannons and torpedoes, as the Databank says. A selector for them is not shown.
controls.context: The pilot uses the heavy weapons against big ships.

areas.name: Flight controls
areas.text: The hand controls the pilot flies with.

panels.name: Flight controls
panels.text: The hand controls in front of the pilot.
panels.context: They fly the ship while the pod stays level.

controls.name: Flight controls
controls.text: The flight controls tip the nose up and down and roll the ship. When it rolls, the hull turns around the pod and the cockpit stays level.
controls.context: This is the special trick of the B-wing: the pilot's view does not roll with the ship.

controls.name: Fire control
controls.text: A control on the flight grips fires the B-wing's cannons.
controls.context: The cannons sit along the long main wing.

panels.name: Throttle
panels.text: This stands for the control that sets the craft's speed.
panels.context: Return of the Jedi does not show this control clearly; the catalog adds it so a joystick set has a place for the speed.

controls.name: Throttle (not clearly shown)
controls.text: This axis stands for the craft's speed: forward for faster, back for slower. The screen does not show where the real control sits, so its place is a guess.
controls.context: On a stick and throttle set this is the throttle lever; in the work itself the pilot is mostly seen with both hands on the flight controls.
